item.title: ICC under fire for perceived double standards over travel plans of ousted T20 World Cup teams
item.description: Disruptions due to military strikes in the Middle East involving USA, Israel and Iran have thrown travel plans haywire acorss the globe and kept South Africa and West Indies stranded in India after they were ousted from the T20 World Cup.

item.title: Aadhaar app allow hotel check-ins without physical ID, Here’s how to use
item.description: A new video shared by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) shows how travellers could use the Aadhaar App to verify their identity digitally during hotel check-ins. The system uses face authentication and a QR code to confirm details without requiring a physical ID card.

item.title: Gold prices: Geopolitical tensions, strong Dollar fuel volatility this week
item.description: Gold prices experienced a turbulent week, driven by intense geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Initial surges reflected safe-haven demand amidst global uncertainty.

item.title: Sebi approves IPO for 3 companies: To mobilise up to Rs 3,330 crore; check details
item.description: Market regulator Sebi has approved the public issues of Bonbloc Technologies, Eastman Auto and Power and Milestone Gears. These companies plan to raise well over Rs 3,000 crore through fresh issues and offers for sale and will list their shares on BSE and NSE.

item.title: Box office report: The Kerala Story 2, Mrithyunjay, Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu and more
item.description: Clash of titans at March 2026 box office. Mrithyunjay’s thrilling murders (Rs 2.6cr), Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu’s heartfelt drama (Rs 1.12cr), Hoppers 3D family fun (Rs 0.65cr) debut March 6. Thaai Kizhavi’s mother fury (Rs 42.75cr) and Kerala Story 2’s bold sequel (Rs 34.65cr) dominate from Feb 27, fueling India’s cinema frenzy.

item.title: Centre seeks explanation from West Bengal over ‘protocol lapses’ during President Murmu’s visit
item.description: In a letter to the West Bengal Chief Secretary, the Union Home Secretary asked the state to clarify the circumstances surrounding the alleged breach of the ‘Blue Book’ protocol rules, including arrangements related to the venue, security and route during the President’s visit.
